good_thing: (West Kalimantan, Indonesia): Conservation officers and the Indonesian Orangutan Rehabilitation Foundation rescued six orangutans stranded in community plantations after fires cut off their access to forest. The group included two mothers with nursing young; after examination and treatment, all six went to a rehabilitation center for monitoring, and the youngest continued nursing.
current_or_history: On September 12, 1940, four teenagers explored a small opening above Montignac, France, and discovered the painted Lascaux cave. Marcel Ravidat, 17, returned with Jacques Marsal, Georges Agniel, and Simon Coencas; with a quickly made lamp, they reached what is now called the Axial Gallery and saw its first paintings.
tiny_fact: Rice seeds can respond to the vibrations of falling rain. In controlled experiments, submerged seeds germinated faster when exposed to those vibrations, which can jostle their tiny gravity-sensing structures, called statoliths.
thought: Some worthwhile things begin with noticing a small opening and bringing a little light.
